title: The Language of Anderlecht
author: Xanthe Vane
blurb: Zephyrine Hartwell, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
